name: chart
useFor: Use for figures over time or by category: orders per day, uptime, spend by merchant. Wrap a LineChart, AreaChart, BarChart or PieChart in ChartContainer with a config naming each series, then add ChartTooltip with ChartTooltipContent and ChartLegend with ChartLegendContent. Format figures with valueFormatter.
constraints: Charts that animate on every hover
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (features.tsx uptime and speed bars, monitoring.tsx)
title: Chart
description: SVG line, area, bar and donut charts with hairline rules, mono axis labels, the blue series first and a white tooltip.
